description: High-performance browser application using Rust-compiled WebAssembly for intensive computations.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. an image processor or heavy data cruncher using WebAssembly
ui.description: Heavy computation runs in the browser as Rust compiled to WebAssembly, behind a plain HTML page, for near-native speed.

sample_prompts: Build a Mandelbrot set renderer that computes fractals in WASM
Create an image grayscale converter that processes pixels using WebAssembly
Make a sorting algorithm visualizer that benchmarks performance in WASM vs JS
kit_prompt_prefix: Create a high-performance WebAssembly application using Rust.
